tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plain-text (HTTP) exception for internal hosts. The existing certificate management is relied on to provide the certificates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the current decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plain-HTTP exception for internal hosts, using the certificate management the project already has.

Muninn has two records on this that it marks as conflicting, and both are still active:
- **#13:** an earlier statement allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts because they sit behind the firewall.
- **#32:** a later statement (about 6 minutes after #13) says HTTPS everywhere with no plain-text exception. The assistant's reply at the time said it replaces the #13 exception.

I went with #32 because it is the later one and says outright that it replaces #13. The file doesn't mention the retired plain-HTTP option. Muninn hasn't formally retired #13, though, so if you want the conflict settled on record, confirm which one stands.
